ideas.title: Uncovering the Extent of Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of child care fraud across the country, including the amounts of money involved and the individuals and organizations accused.
questions: How much money has been defrauded from the child care system?
Who are the key players involved in the scheme?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale scheme, with millions of dollars at stake. By following the money and investigating the key players, we can shed light on the extent of the fraud and bring those responsible to justice.
